_comment: Skills Passport — evidence-based competencies. Levels: Developing / Intermediate / Advanced. Never a professional qualification. No XP, coins, badges or leaderboards. Progress is from recorded evidence (lesson, assessment, calculation, Grid Lab, capstone) — not from visiting a page.
disclaimer: Course completion record, not a qualification. TransformerPath is not an accreditation body and does not licence engineers.
evidence_note: A video watch contributes to progress only. Skills Passport levels require assessment, calculation, Grid Lab or capstone evidence. Never a professional qualification. Opening a Lab or a 3D view is not evidence.
